mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I’m really glad you’re here, because what we’re about to explore together isn’t just a story about sports—it’s about the powerful intersection of triumph and adversity, and what happens when a person is pushed to their absolute limits. Imagine the intensity of elite cycling—every moment defined by sheer ambition, discipline, and the hunger to win. Now, picture what happens when all of that is suddenly overshadowed by something much bigger: a battle for life itself. That’s the heart of Lance Armstrong’s journey, as told in It’s Not About the Bike: My Journey Back to Life by Lance Armstrong. Here, the finish line isn’t just about medals or glory; it’s about facing down life-changing illness and discovering what courage, vulnerability, and hope really mean. As we dive in, we’ll see how the fight against cancer becomes a turning point—not just for Armstrong’s career, but for his sense of self, his relationships, and what success truly feels like. It’s not only about reclaiming a spot in the peloton. It’s about finding meaning, resilience, and a new purpose when everything you thought you knew gets turned upside down. So, as we set out on this journey together, get ready to look beyond the race—and discover what it really takes to persevere when the odds seem overwhelming.
